————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, December 20, 2017/Agrahayana 29, 1939 (Saka)

(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Skill Development and Entrepreneurship; Steel;
Tourism; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 15
16
Disciplinary proceedings and
investigations against IPS
officers
*46. SHRI SANJIV KUMAR: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) how many IPS officers are currently
facing disciplinary proceedings and
investigations by Central and State
investigating agencies;
(b) in reference to part (a) above, in how
many cases FIRs have been registered and
after investigation, chargesheets have been
filed; and
(c) how many IPS officers have been
retired by Government by invoking Rule
16(3) of the AIS (DCRB) Rules, 1958 since
2014?
Unemployment among youth
*47. MS. DOLA SEN: Will the Minister
of LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) how many unemployed youth have
been given employment by the Central
Government during the last one year;
and
(b) how many youth were employed
during the last three years?
Revision of retail prices of petrol/
diesel/LPG
*48. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS
be pleased to state:
(a) how many times the retail prices of
petrol, diesel and LPG were revised, give
the date and the amount increased/
decreased, since May, 2014;
(b) what is the tax component in these
prices; and
(c) what are the details of variation in
crude prices during this period?

17
Investigations into killings of Kashmiri
Pandits
*49. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large
number of FIRs registered for the killings
of Kashmiri Pandits in the 1990s have not
been investigated by the State Government
of Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) whether it is also a fact that leaders
of Kashmiri Pandit body had also
approached the Central Government in this
regard but no action was taken thereon; and
(c) if so, what are the specific reasons
therefor and by when directions are
proposed to be issued to the State
Government of Jammu and Kashmir to
initiate investigations into the killings of
Kashmiri Pandits?
Fall in prices of pepper
*50. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that prices of
superior quality pepper have fallen due to
increase in its production;
(b) whether it is also a fact that cheap
and low quality Vietnamese pepper is
finding its way into India through Sri Lanka
under South Asian Free Trade Area
Agreement which is severely impacting
pepper growers in south Indian States,
particularly Kerala and Karnataka; and
(c) what measures the Ministry propose
to take to stop the unethical inflow of
inferior quality pepper from Vietnam
through Sri Lanka so that the prices of
pepper get stabilized and its growers are
protected?
Increase in prices of petrol
and diesel
†*51. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has decided to
fix the prices of petrol and diesel on a daily
basis and whether it is a fact that the prices
of petrol and diesel have been rising
continuously since this decision was taken
even as the price of crude oil is very low in
the international market;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the details of total cost of
production of petrol and diesel and their
delivery to the market?
Skill development in Saansad Adarsh
Grams
†*52. DR. SUBHASH CHANDRA:
Will the Minister of SKILL
DEVELOPMENT AND
ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of employment
opportunities created till date for the skilled
manpower in Saansad Adarsh Grams, the
State-wise details thereof;
(b) the details of various schemes
implemented for the skill development and
creation of employment in Saansad Adarsh
Grams; and
(c) whether any assessment has been
made about the economic growth of such
villages, if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

18
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Increase in incidents of lynching by
mob
*53. SHRI M.P. VEERENDRA
KUMAR: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether incidents of lynching by
mob are reportedly on the rise in the
country and if so, the details thereof and
the reasons therefor;
(b) the total number of such cases
reported, persons killed/injured, arrested
and the action taken against them during
each of the last three years, State-wise;
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to bring a stringent law against
mob lynching and if so, the details thereof;
and
(d) the other measures taken by
Government to stop such incidents in
future?
Removal of prohibition on pulses'
export
*54. SHRI D. KUPENDRA  REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE

111
Increase in trade deficit
481. SHRI M. P. VEERENDRA
KUMAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the exports
have drastically come down due to which
the foreign trade deficit has reached at an
alarming level;
(b) if so, the details thereof, sector-wise
and the reasons therefor; and
(c) the names of countries with which
India has registered favourable trade
balance during the last three years, sector-
wise and year-wise?
India - Canada CEPA talks
482. SHRI MAJEED MEMON: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that even after
the 10th round of the India-Canada
Comprehensive Economic Partnership
Agreement (CEPA) talks held in August,
2017 both sides are still looking for a
breakthrough in long-pending negotiations
for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA), if so,
the reasons therefor; and
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government has agreed to accept clauses
like Ratchet and Most Favoured Nation
(MFN) in services and investment, if so,
the list of sectors India has agreed to?
Dumping of Chinese steel
483. DR. PRADEEP KUMAR
BALMUCHU: Will the Minister of STEEL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the steel
industry in the country has been facing
innumerable problems due to dumping of
Chinese steel and downward trend of
international steel markets;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the remedial measures taken/being

112
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
taken by Government to safeguard the
indigenous steel industry?
Fall in growth of manufacturing sector
†484. SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
YADA V:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
growth of manufacturing sector has
witnessed unprecedented decline;
(b) if so, the details of growth in
manufacturing sector, including leather,
textiles, steel, etc. during the last two years
and the current year, year-wise;
(c) whether Government has assessed
the impact of this decline on Indian
industries;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the measures Government has taken
in this regard?
Impact of 'Make in India' programme
on industries
485. SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
YADA V:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 'Make in
India' programme has become a total
failure;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
there are adverse impacts on Indian
industries resulting in several youths
becoming jobless, if so, the reasons
therefor, including the number of people
who have lost their job, sector-wise and
State/UT-wise; and
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the corrective steps taken by Government
in this regard especially with regard to the
possible impact on Indian industries?
Trade between India and European
countries
486. SHRI P. BHATTACHARYA:
SHRIMATI RAJANI PA TIL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the volume of trade carried out
between India and European countries
during the last three years and the current
year, country-wise;
(b) whether there is adequate potential
for Indian exports to these countries;
(c) if so, the details thereof along with
the steps taken by Government to increase
the exports to these countries and to explore
the new markets; and
(d) the success achieved by Government
in this regard?
Protection against cheap and sub-
standard imports
487. SHRI NARAYAN LAL
PANCHARIYA: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
any measures to protect the interest of
Indian manufacturers against cheap and
sub-standard imports;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;

113
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether any step is being taken to
promote that the goods imported into India
have some local sourcing connection; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Expenditure on 'Startup India'
programme
488. SHRI TIRUCHI SIV A: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many Startups have been
benefited under the 'Startup India' scheme;
(b) how much expenditure has been
incurred by Government over the 'Startup
India' programme; and
(c) what is the estimated number of
people employed in these 'Startups'?
Pending FDI proposals

INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of pending F
